notes: Breadboard coordinates read from the image using the catalogue convention: rows f-j are bank 'b'.

The LED's longer, bent anode leg is in column 6 (row i) and its cathode is in column 8 (row i). The resistor spans columns 4 and 6 in row h. The resistor's second leg sits in the same column strip as the LED anode, so the resistor is in series between pin 9 and the anode.
The orange wire is in 4b.g, which shares a strip with the resistor leg in 4b.h. The black wire is in 8b.h, which shares a strip with the LED cathode in 8b.i.
The black wire goes to the GND pin in the digital header, next to AREF, which is GND.1 here.
The manual and schematic say 220 ohm; the resistor's colour bands in the image are not read.
